3:52 A
BACK SQUAT - DELOAD
•I LTE C
4 Sets, 1 Set Every 4:00
5 Back Squats @ 60-65% of IRM
*All sets, same weight across*
Accessory Between Sets:
10 TOES elevated DB Romanian deadlifts
16 Landmine twists
Score: weight lifted for 4 sets.
Coming off our 10RM testing, were reducing the weight and volume to allow our bodies to recover.
We're keeping all four sets at the same 60-65% because the goal isn't to build heavier today.
Focus on quality reps, good technique, and moving the bar with intent without adding unnecessary fatigue to nt just your muscles, but your nervous system!
The weight should feel comfortable throughout.
Resist the urge to go heavier. We're recovering now so we can lift heavier later.

3:53
all LTE L
INTENT
Coming off our Back Squat deload, were keeping things moving with some rowing, running, and light dumbbell work.
Find a comfortable pace on the row and Run, keep the Reverse Lunges continuos with good posture, and focus on a strong midline as you alternate arms on the Strict Press. Choose a dumbbell that allows you to move consistently without approaching failure.
We're keeping the intensity lower this week as we prepare for next weeks heavy single testing. Aim for RPE 5-7 and finish feeling like you could have kept going.
The 18 reps are intentional, representing October 18,1587, when Filipino sailors first arrived on the coast of what is now California. A little history built into today's workout.
